# Clean Release Protocol

The Awtsmoos is beyond branch, tree, and deployment; Awtsmoos.com nevertheless reveals finite release truth through one exact immutable SHA rather than through a dirty checkout.

## Why the current checkout must not be pushed wholesale

- Local branch is `main` but committed history is 3 commits ahead and 26 commits behind current `origin/main`.
- Working tree contains roughly 1,510 dirty paths, much of it unrelated concurrent work.
- Many Geelooy commerce/retention/reconciliation modules are new/untracked relative to remote main.
- Production hard-resets Hetzner to the exact pushed GitHub SHA and cleans untracked files.

## Current safe construction strategy

Build an immutable candidate commit without changing the real index, branch, or working tree:

1. Create a temporary Git index.
2. `git read-tree origin/main` into that temporary index.
3. Stage only the audited release areas into that temporary index, including tracked edits, deletions, and untracked files.
4. `git write-tree`.
5. `git commit-tree <tree> -p origin/main` to create a candidate commit directly parented on current remote main.
6. Verify the candidate contains every critical commerce, retention, reconciliation, catalog, SEO, and server-injection module.

## Audited release areas

- `geelooy/shared/commerce`
- `geelooy/api/wallet/core/commerce`
- `geelooy/api/wallet/routes`
- `geelooy/api/wallet/tests`
- `geelooy/scripts/awtsmoos/ui`
- `geelooy/style/premium/product-commerce`
- `geelooy/style/premium/product-memory.css`
- `geelooy/apps/scripts/catalog`
- `geelooy/apps/scripts/filter`
- `geelooy/games/scripts/catalog`
- `geelooy/games/scripts/storefront`
- `geelooy/seo`
- `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/static`
- `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/server`

## Candidate validation

Materialize only the immutable candidate commit into a clean checkout. Then run the same release gates as `.github/workflows/main.yml` under Node 24 where available:

- `node --check scripts/verifyHomeProduction.mjs`
- runtime quality tests
- production tests
- City of Light release-surface test
- static asset representation + HTML product metadata tests
- `npm run test:routes`
- `npm run test:css-quality`
- `npm run repo:hygiene`
- `npm run test:concurrency-failure`
- the workflow's Rebbe/living-library/heichel release checks
- the complete Geelooy commerce/retention/reconciliation/SEO platform suite used during this hardening pass

## Promotion gate

Before pushing:

- inspect `git diff origin/main..candidate` and reject unrelated subsystems;
- ensure candidate parent is the current fetched `origin/main` SHA;
- ensure no required file exists only in the dirty development checkout;
- ensure all production and product gates are green.

Only then update `main` to the exact candidate SHA. GitHub Actions will verify the same SHA, SSH to Hetzner, hard-reset the production checkout to it, clean untracked files, activate the canonical server, and execute public release verification.

## Revenue truth

This release system protects a real monetization engine—80 monetizable products, 240 product-credit packs, durable Radiance entitlements, Wallet settlement, reconciliation diagnostics, retention, discovery, and mobile conversion surfaces. It optimizes the conditions for revenue but cannot guarantee any dollar rate or permanence of income.
